name: claude-plugins
description: A curated collection of Claude Code plugins for development workflows, code review, security, and productivity

plugins.name: pr-review-toolkit
plugins.description: Comprehensive PR review agents specializing in comments, tests, error handling, type design, code quality, and code simplification

plugins.name: feature-dev
plugins.description: Comprehensive feature development workflow with specialized agents for codebase exploration, architecture design, and quality review

plugins.name: commit-commands
plugins.description: Commands for git commit workflows including commit, push, and PR creation

plugins.name: hookify
plugins.description: Easily create custom hooks to prevent unwanted behaviors by analyzing conversation patterns or from explicit instructions

plugins.name: plugin-dev
plugins.description: Comprehensive toolkit for developing Claude Code plugins including hooks, MCP integration, commands, agents, and skills

plugins.name: frontend-design
plugins.description: Create distinctive, production-grade frontend interfaces with high design quality. Generates creative, polished code that avoids generic AI aesthetics

plugins.name: code-modernization
plugins.description: Architecture review and code modernization with adversarial analysis

plugins.name: security-guidance
plugins.description: Senior security engineer agent for finding vulnerabilities including injection, auth flaws, insecure crypto, SSRF, XSS, and common CWEs

plugins.name: code-simplifier
plugins.description: Refactor and simplify code for clarity, consistency, and maintainability while preserving functionality

plugins.name: debug
plugins.description: Systematic debugging workflow: reproduce first, write failing test, then fix

plugins.name: test-toolkit
plugins.description: Specialized agents for writing tests and analyzing test coverage quality

plugins.name: performance
plugins.description: Performance profiling, optimization, and dependency audit agents

plugins.name: documentation
plugins.description: Documentation engineering and specialized framework development agents

plugins.name: session
plugins.description: Session management tools for context window monitoring and conversation handoff

plugins.name: claude-md-management
plugins.description: Audit, evaluate quality, and improve CLAUDE.md files. Captures session learnings and keeps project memory up to date.

plugins.name: claude-code-setup
plugins.description: Analyze a codebase and recommend Claude Code automations (hooks, subagents, skills, plugins, MCP servers)

plugins.name: mcp-server-dev
plugins.description: Build high-quality MCP servers: remote HTTP, MCPB bundles, and MCP apps with UI widgets

plugins.name: mcp-builder
plugins.description: Build high-quality MCP servers using FastMCP or the MCP SDK

plugins.name: skill-creator
plugins.description: Create new skills, modify and improve existing skills, and measure skill performance

plugins.name: claude-api
plugins.description: Build, debug, and optimize Claude API and Anthropic SDK applications

plugins.name: webapp-testing
plugins.description: Test local web applications with Playwright, taking screenshots, checking console logs, and automating browser interactions

plugins.name: web-artifacts-builder
plugins.description: Build complex HTML artifacts (React, Tailwind, shadcn/ui) with state management for inline rendering in Claude

plugins.name: session-report
plugins.description: Generates a visual HTML report summarizing Claude Code session activity, time spent, and key decisions
